verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter lists O-1 among the work visas it handles, though framed for employers (docs-13). It says it tells applicants upfront whether their case qualifies, but that is tied to the NIW refund offer (docs-3). It also helps candidates choose a strategy after learning their accomplishments (docs-2, docs-4). It never documents a structured O-1A assessment or explains how evidence is weighed against the USCIS criteria. Missing for 10: a documented O-1A-specific qualification assessment, published methodology mapping evidence to the USCIS extraordinary-ability criteria, a founder-facing (self-petition) O-1A offering, and independent corroboration.
